verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a local-first workflow: "Develop and iterate locally, then share and scale in the cloud" with the DuckDB CLI and SDKs. The dbt-duckdb adapter targets local DuckDB and MotherDuck by changing only the `path:` setting, and local databases can be uploaded to the cloud. A no-credit-card free trial and Lite plan with free storage and compute add a free cloud dev tier. Community feedback welcomes hybrid local/remote querying. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on dev-to-prod environment promotion and parity, and independent hands-on corroboration of the local dbt dev loop.
